The name Arick carries the meaning “Bold ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arick usually hope their child will grow to embody bold ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
